art.title: The Merry Family
art.credit: Public domain · image via Wikimedia Commons (Google Art Project)
art.story: A father raises his glass and sings at the top of his voice, the mother sings along, a baby waves from its chair, and the children copy them: a boy blows on a flute at the window, others puff on clay pipes. The dog sniffs for scraps, a platter lies on the floor beside a big jug, and flowers stand on the mantelpiece. On the paper pinned to the wall is a Dutch saying: "As the old sing, so pipe the young." Jan Steen painted this kind of happy mess so often that the Dutch still call an untidy home "a Jan Steen household".
